name: Ollie
source:
Pronouns: They/Them

A shy student who Nova meets shortly after hanging out with Mitzi. They ask Nova to help them become friends with her.

They suffer from narcolepsy and frequently fall asleep mid-conversation. [spoiler]They have the ability to communicate with ghosts.[/spoiler]
